game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected banners into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the town gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Drag collected banners into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the town gate. Each round, bandits strike the town gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the town gate from bandits in Watchtower Ring: keep the crate_b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: crate_b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while crate_b > 0.
